summary: One shared learning platform now supports independently built company frontends and explicitly configured local workspaces. The Makitra personal reference covers labs, linked practice and transfer using its actual design system. The standard Gym and company frontend share evidence, answer receipts, recovery intent and namespaced drafts. JavaScript development/build/CI uses pnpm.
rationale: D-012 records the explicitly authorized experience boundary. D-001–D-011 and A-001–A-007 semantics, thresholds and versions remain intact. ALGORITHMS.md only updates the location of shared rich renderers. Added read-model documentation does not filter API responses. Workspace configuration selects existing Store/worker/planner services, without adding tenancy or provider authority. Shared request recovery prevents uncertain session creation from being repeated; default and company screens share per-question drafts. CODEOWNERS/check coverage expands to the new packages, tests and pnpm lockfiles without changing owners or disabling existing checks.
authorization: User explicitly requested implementation of the complete Experience adaptation layer: agent-built company frontends plan on codex/experience-adaptation, including independent React/Vite apps, the frontend integration kit, local workspaces, Makitra, D-012, documentation, change records and committed-diff checks. User subsequently requested: could you change npm to pnpm from now on? Save in memory. Preference also saved in global Codex AGENTS.md outside this repository. No publication or merge is authorized or performed.

Existing test:rich-labs passed editor/preview/publication/media/tutor and adversarial sandbox checks. Actual read responses validate against documented DTOs. Exported starter installs with frozen lockfile/builds/checks/tests; Makitra builds outside the backend checkout with only exported kit and design-system archive. Skill validation and git diff --check passed. Docker image builds using pnpm; production-container kit export passed. Architecture structural checks passed; check_architecture.py --base dbe8320a3f7995456f8f48fb135b536fc68dd097 must run after this change is committed. No real learner data or external models were used in validation. GitHub enforcement and an actual Claude Design handoff were not exercised.
rollback: Open the standard Gym at /, or remove the experience from that workspace configuration and restart. Existing databases, original files, content, visits, attempts, jobs and plans require no rewrite. A code rollback must pair the shared-client changes with the default frontend wrappers. Keep private workspaces and the existing default database intact. For package-manager rollback restore the prior package manifest/lockfile and matching CI/Docker commands together.
